mapper.select: select Sum(CO_TureMoney) from BG_ContactOrder where State = 7 and CO_ConId = #{conId} and (CO_BL != 0 or CO_BL is null) and id not in (select vo_GLID from BG_VisaOrder where state = 7)

select co.id as id, co.CO_Code as code, '工程联系单' as type, co.CO_PId as pId, pp.P_Name as pName, co.CO_ConId as conId, cc.Con_Name as conName, IFNUll(co.CO_GLBL,100) as BL, co.CO_TureMoney as Money, 100 as TrueBL, co.CO_TureMoney as TrueMoney from BG_ContactOrder co left join Con_Contract cc on cc.Con_Id = co.Con_Id left join pre_project pp on pp.P_ID = co.P_Id where co.State = 7 and (co.CO_BL != 0 or co.CO_BL is null) and co.id not in (select vo_GLID from BG_VisaOrder where state = 7)
and INSTR(co.CO_Code,#{request.code})
and INSTR(cc.con_name,#{request.conName})
and likePname(#{request.pName},pp.P_Id)=true
and INSTR(pp.p_name,#{request.pName})
select ifnull(sum(co_Glbl),0) from BG_ContactOrder where state = 7 and co_Glid = #{contactItemId}
